title: Impilo nomzimba
description: Ten short, simple stories about health and the body: a boy's sore ear after a dirty river, a tired pastor who learns to rest, an old woman's vegetable garden, a health messenger and circumcision, a woman who leaves an abusive husband, a young man who stops drinking, a schoolgirl's new glasses, a young boxer who learns his limit, a box of medicine from overseas, and a young woman's falling hair.

lessons.title: Indlebe kaNtsikelelo
lessons.summary: Young Ntsikelelo from Ndwedwe swims in a deep, dirty river against his mother's word; his ear hurts, his mother Thobile takes him on a long bus ride to the hospital, and the doctor finds a germ from the dirty water and tells him to avoid such water.
lessons.text:
UNtsikelelo ungumfana omncane. Uhlala eNdwedwe nomama wakhe, uThobile. Eduze nekhaya labo kukhona umfula. Amanzi omfula ajulile, futhi angcolile. UThobile uthi kuNtsikelelo: "Ungangeni emfuleni. Amanzi awo ajulile, futhi angcolile."

Ngolunye usuku kushisa kakhulu. UNtsikelelo nabangane bakhe baya emfuleni. Bangena emanzini ajulile, badlala isikhathi eside.

Ebusuku uNtsikelelo uyakhala. Uthi: "Mama, indlebe yami ayilungile." UThobile uyethuka. Ubheka indlebe yengane yakhe. Uyabuza: "Ungene emfuleni na?" UNtsikelelo uthi: "Yebo, mama. Angilalelanga."

Ekuseni uThobile uthatha uNtsikelelo, baye esibhedlela. Isibhedlela sikude nekhaya labo. Bahamba ngebhasi. Ebhasini kunabantu abaningi. Ibhasi lihamba kancane, futhi indlela inde. Endleleni uNtsikelelo uyakhala, ngoba indlebe yakhe ayilungile. UThobile ubamba isandla sengane yakhe.

Esibhedlela balinda umzuzu, bese balinda eminye imizuzu eminingi. Ekugcineni udokotela uyababiza.

Udokotela ubheka indlebe kaNtsikelelo. Uthi: "Kunegciwane endlebeni yakhe. Leli gciwane livela emanzini angcolile. Amagciwane amaningi ahlala emanzini angcolile. Angalimaza indlebe kakhulu." UThobile uyethuka futhi. Uthi: "Igciwane lizoyilimaza indlebe yakhe na?" Udokotela uthi: "Cha. Ngizomnika umuthi. Faka umuthi endlebeni yakhe kathathu ngosuku."

Bese udokotela uthi kuNtsikelelo: "Gwema amanzi angcolile, futhi ugweme amanzi ajulile. Amanzi angcolile angakulimaza."

Babuyela ekhaya ngebhasi. Ikhaya labo likude, futhi indlela inde, kodwa manje uNtsikelelo uyajabula. Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa indlebe yakhe isilungile. Manje uyawagwema amanzi omfula.

Imibuzo:
UNtsikelelo uhlala eThekwini na?
Cha, uhlala eNdwedwe nomama wakhe.
Amanzi omfula angcolile na?
Kunjalo, angcolile futhi ajulile.
Isibhedlela siseduze nekhaya labo na?
Cha, sikude. Bahamba ngebhasi.
Kukhona igciwane endlebeni kaNtsikelelo na?
Kunjalo, kunegciwane endlebeni yakhe.
Manje uNtsikelelo uyawagwema amanzi omfula na?
Kunjalo, uyawagwema.

lessons.title: Umfundisi uyaphumula
lessons.summary: Pastor Mlamuli of KwaMashu works day and night, forgets to eat at midday and has bad dreams; after he falls in church, Doctor Nomhle tells him to rest, so he settles at home, prays for blessing and learns to rest in the evenings.
lessons.text:
UMfundisi Mlamuli uhlala eKwaMashu. Ungumfundisi webandla elikhulu. Usebenza kakhulu. Ekuseni ufundisa abantu ebandleni. Emini uvakashela abantu esibhedlela. Ebusuku ubhala izindaba zeSonto. Akaphumuli. Ngisho ngeSonto akaphumuli.

UMfundisi Mlamuli uyakhohlwa ukudla. Emini akadli, ngoba unomsebenzi omningi. Ebusuku akalali kahle, ngoba unemicabango eminingi. Umcabango owodwa uyahamba, bese kufika omunye. Uma elala, unamaphupho amabi.

Izolo emini uMfundisi Mlamuli uwile phansi esontweni. Abantu bebandla bethukile kakhulu. Bamthatha, bahamba naye esibhedlela.

Udokotela, uNomhle, uyamhlola. Uhlola amehlo akhe, igazi lakhe nenhliziyo yakhe. Uthi: "Mfundisi, umzimba wakho udinga ukuphumula. Izolo awudlanga emini, futhi awulalanga ebusuku. Kumele uphumule. Ungakhohlwa ukudla emini. Futhi ungakhohlwa ukulala."

UMfundisi Mlamuli uthi: "Kodwa abantu bebandla bayangidinga." UNomhle uthi: "Bazokudinga nangonyaka ozayo. Ngakho phumula manje." UMfundisi Mlamuli uthi: "Kulungile, dokotela. Ngizophumula."

UMfundisi Mlamuli uya ekhaya. Uhlala phansi ngaphandle, uyazinza. Uvala amehlo. Ukhuleka kuNkulunkulu. Uthi: "Nkulunkulu, ngibusise. Busisa nabantu bebandla lami. Ngisize ngiphumule." Ngosuku olulandelayo uyadla emini, futhi ulala kahle ebusuku.

Ngemuva kwezinsuku eziningi umzimba wakhe uqinile futhi. Imicabango yakhe isizinzile. Ulala kahle, futhi amaphupho akhe mahle. Manje usebenza ekuseni nasemini kuphela. Ebusuku uyaphumula ekhaya. Abantu bebandla bayajabula, ngoba umfundisi wabo uphilile futhi.

NgeSonto elilandelayo ukhuleka ebandleni nabantu bonke. Uthi: "Nkulunkulu ungibusisile. Ngifunde ukuphumula. Ningakhohlwa ukuphumula nani."

Imibuzo:
UMfundisi Mlamuli uhlala eKwaMashu na?
Kunjalo, uhlala eKwaMashu.
Uyadla emini na?
Cha, uyakhohlwa ukudla emini.
Unamaphupho amahle ebusuku na?
Cha, unamaphupho amabi.
Udokotela uthi kumele aphumule na?
Kunjalo, uthi kumele aphumule.
Manje uMfundisi Mlamuli uyaphumula ebusuku na?
Kunjalo, ebusuku uyaphumula ekhaya.

lessons.title: Insimu kaNombuso
lessons.summary: Old Nombuso of Nquthu is told by the doctor to eat green plants and fish; she sows seed, the dry soil waits for rain, she harvests, trades her greens for fish and mutton with the farmer Khanyo under a big tree, and eats a full plate.
lessons.text:
UNombuso ungowesifazane omdala. Uhlala eNquthu. Ngolunye usuku uya esibhedlela. Udokotela uthi kuye: "Umzimba wakho udinga ukudla okuhle. Yidla izitshalo eziluhlaza nezinhlanzi."

UNombuso unensimu encane ngemuva kwendlu yakhe. Uthenga imbewu edolobheni. Utshala imbewu ensimini yakhe. Kodwa imvula ayikho. Umhlabathi womile. Izitshalo ezincane nazo ziyoma.

UNombuso uletha amanzi emfuleni nsuku zonke. Kodwa umfula ukude, futhi amanzi awanele. Uthi: "Nkulunkulu, sicela imvula."

Ngemuva kwesonto imvula iyana. Ina izinsuku ezintathu. Manje umhlabathi unamanzi. Izitshalo ziyakhula, ziluhlaza kakhulu.

Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezimbili uNombuso uyavuna. Uvuna izitshalo eziningi eziluhlaza. Kodwa akanazo izinhlanzi.

Eduze kwakhe kuhlala umlimi, uKhanyo. UKhanyo unezimvu eziningi, futhi ubamba izinhlanzi emfuleni. UNombuso uthi kuKhanyo: "Ake sihwebe. Ngizokunika izitshalo eziluhlaza. Wena unginike izinhlanzi." UKhanyo uyavuma, ngoba naye udinga izitshalo eziluhlaza. Bahweba ngaphansi kwesihlahla esikhulu. UKhanyo uthi: "Ngizokunika nenyama yemvu. Izimvu zami zinkulu."

Ebusuku uNombuso ulungisa ukudla. Ubeka inhlanzi nezitshalo eziluhlaza esitsheni. Ubeka nenyama yemvu esitsheni esincane. Uhlala ngaphandle, ngaphansi kwesihlahla sakhe, adle. Isitsha sakhe sigcwele ukudla okuhle. NoKhanyo udla izitshalo eziluhlaza ekhaya lakhe. Bobabili bayajabula ngokuhweba kwabo.

Ngonyaka olandelayo uNombuso ubuyela esibhedlela. Udokotela uthi: "Umzimba wakho uqinile manje." UNombuso uyajabula. Uthi: "Ngiyavuna, ngiyahweba, futhi ngidla kahle."

Imibuzo:
UNombuso uhlala eNquthu na?
Kunjalo, uhlala eNquthu.
Ekuqaleni imvula ikhona na?
Cha, imvula ayikho, umhlabathi womile.
UNombuso uyavuna izitshalo eziluhlaza na?
Kunjalo, uvuna izitshalo eziningi eziluhlaza.
UKhanyo unezimvu na?
Kunjalo, unezimvu eziningi.
Bahweba ngaphansi kwesihlahla na?
Kunjalo, bahweba ngaphansi kwesihlahla esikhulu.

lessons.title: Isithunywa sezempilo
lessons.summary: Health messenger Thembinkosi visits homes in Nkandla to explain medical circumcision, part of a goal of a million men; young Snethemba agrees, is the fifth of eight men that Thursday, and is well again after seven days of rest.
lessons.text:
UThembinkosi uyisithunywa sezempilo eNkandla. Injongo yakhe ukusiza abantu bendawo ukuthi baphile kahle. Kulo nyaka uhulumeni unenjongo enkulu. Ufuna ukusoka amadoda ayisigidi esifundazweni. Isigidi singamadoda amaningi kakhulu.

UThembinkosi uhamba emizini, uqondisa abantu ngokusoka. Uthi: "Ukusoka kwenziwa ngudokotela esibhedlela. Kuyasiza, ngoba kunciphisa izifo ezithile." Uqondisa kahle futhi kancane, ngakho bonke bayaqonda. Abanye abantu bayesaba ukusoka, kodwa uThembinkosi ukhuluma nabo kahle.

Insizwa, uSnethemba, iyabuza: "Kunokwenzeka ukuthi kube nenkinga ngemuva kokusoka na?" UThembinkosi uthi: "Kunokwenzeka, kodwa akuvamile. Udokotela uzokwenza konke kahle. Phumula izinsuku eziyisikhombisa ngemuva kokusoka."

USnethemba uyavuma. NgoLwesine uya esibhedlela. Inhloko yesibhedlela ikhuluma namadoda. Kulolo suku kukhona amadoda ayisishiyagalombili. Amadoda ayisishiyagalombili alinde ndawonye. USnethemba ungowesihlanu. Amadoda amane angena kuqala, bese kungena owesihlanu, uSnethemba.

Inhloko yesibhedlela iqondisa amadoda ngemuva kokusoka. Ithi: "Phumulani izinsuku eziyisikhombisa. Ningenzi umsebenzi onzima. Uma kukhona inkinga, buyelani lapha ngokushesha."

USnethemba uphumula ekhaya izinsuku eziyisikhombisa. Ngemuva kwezinsuku eziyisikhombisa ubuyela esibhedlela. Udokotela uyamhlola. Uthi: "Konke kuhamba kahle. Umzimba wakho uphilile."

UThembinkosi uyajabula. Uthi: "Injongo yethu yisigidi samadoda. Namuhla sinamadoda ayisishiyagalombili aseNkandla, kodwa kusasa sizoba nabaningi." USnethemba utshela abangane bakhe ngokusoka. Abangane bakhe abahlanu bafuna ukuya esibhedlela. Manje noSnethemba uyisithunywa esincane.

Imibuzo:
UThembinkosi uyisithunywa sezempilo na?
Kunjalo, uyisithunywa sezempilo eNkandla.
Uhulumeni ufuna ukusoka amadoda ayisigidi na?
Kunjalo, ufuna ukusoka amadoda ayisigidi.
NgoLwesine kukhona amadoda ayisishiyagalombili esibhedlela na?
Kunjalo, kukhona amadoda ayisishiyagalombili.
USnethemba ungowokuqala na?
Cha, ungowesihlanu.
USnethemba uphumula izinsuku eziyisikhombisa na?
Kunjalo, uphumula izinsuku eziyisikhombisa ekhaya.

lessons.title: UKhethiwe uthola usizo
lessons.summary: In Vryheid Khethiwe's husband nags, criticises and beats her, and she hides her face; her neighbour Bonisiwe begs her to go to a centre for abused women, where she is helped, and she separates from her husband.
lessons.text:
UKhethiwe uhlala eVryheid nomyeni wakhe nezingane zabo ezimbili. Ekuqaleni umyeni wakhe wamthanda kakhulu. Kodwa manje umyeni uyathetha njalo. Uthetha ngokudla, uthetha ngemali, uthetha ngezingane.

Umyeni uyamgxeka uKhethiwe lapho kukhona abantu. Uthi: "Awazi lutho. Awenzi lutho kahle." Ngezinye izikhathi uyamshaya. UKhethiwe ufihla ubuso bakhe ngengubo, ngoba akafuni ukuthi abantu babone. Ufihla nezandla zakhe.

Umakhelwane wakhe, uBonisiwe, ubona konke. Ngolunye usuku uBonisiwe uthi: "Khethiwe, umyeni wakho uyakuhlukumeza. Lokhu kungububi obukhulu. Akukho muntu onelungelo lokukuhlukumeza."

UKhethiwe uthi: "Angifuni ukukhuluma ngakho. Umyeni wami uzothetha kakhulu." Kodwa uBonisiwe uyamnxusa: "Ngiyakunxusa, mngane wami. Hamba endaweni yokusiza abesifazane edolobheni. Lapho basiza abesifazane abahlukumezekile. Basiza nabesifazane abadlwengulwa. Abesifazane abaningi badlwengulwa noma bashaywa, kodwa abatsheli muntu. Abasebenzi khona abagxeki muntu."

UKhethiwe uyacabanga ubusuku bonke. Ekuseni uhamba noBonisiwe edolobheni. Owesifazane walapho uyamlalela. Uthi: "Akufanele ufihle lokhu. Ububi bomyeni wakho abusilo iphutha lakho."

Abasebenzi bayamsiza uKhethiwe. Bamsiza ukuthi athole indawo yokuhlala. Ekugcineni uKhethiwe uyehlukana nomyeni wakhe. Uhlala nezingane zakhe endlini encane eduze komakhelwane wakhe.

Manje akekho othethayo ekhaya. Akekho omgxekayo. UKhethiwe akafihli ubuso bakhe futhi. Ngolunye usuku uBonisiwe uyamvakashela. UKhethiwe uthi: "Ngiyajabula, makhelwane wami. Wanginxusa, ngakho ngahamba."

Imibuzo:
Umyeni kaKhethiwe uyathetha njalo na?
Kunjalo, uthetha ngokudla, ngemali nangezingane.
UKhethiwe ufihla ubuso bakhe na?
Kunjalo, ufihla ubuso bakhe ngengubo.
UBonisiwe ungumakhelwane kaKhethiwe na?
Kunjalo, ungumakhelwane wakhe.
UBonisiwe uyamnxusa uKhethiwe na?
Kunjalo, uyamnxusa ukuthi ahambe edolobheni.
Ekugcineni uKhethiwe uyehlukana nomyeni wakhe na?
Kunjalo, uyehlukana naye.

lessons.title: Utshwala bukaLangelihle
lessons.summary: Langelihle and Siphokazi of Soweto love each other, but his drinking grows, he runs into debt and makes up stories while she answers with sarcasm; after a fall the doctor says the alcohol has spoiled his health, and he stops, pays back his friends and they marry.
lessons.text:
ULangelihle noSiphokazi bayathandana. Bahlala eSoweto. Bathandana kakhulu, futhi bafuna ukushada.

Kodwa uLangelihle uphuza utshwala. Ekuqaleni uphuza kancane ngoMgqibelo kuphela. Lokho kwaba yisiqalo senkinga. Manje uphuza utshwala nsuku zonke ebusuku.

Utshwala buyabiza. ULangelihle akanayo imali eyanele. Ucela imali kubangane bakhe. Manje unesikweletu esikhulu. Isikweletu sakhe sikhula nyanga zonke.

ULangelihle uqamba amanga kuSiphokazi. Uthi: "Angiphuzanga izolo. Ngisebenzile ebusuku." Kodwa uSiphokazi uyazi iqiniso. Uyamba. Uthi: "Yebo, yebo. Usebenza kakhulu ebusuku. Umsebenzi wakho umnandi kakhulu, akunjalo?" ULangelihle uqamba enye indaba. USiphokazi uyamba futhi: "Yebo, leyo yindaba enhle kakhulu!"

Ngolunye usuku uLangelihle uwa phansi emgwaqweni. Abantu bayasondela, bamthathe, bahambe naye esibhedlela. Udokotela uyamhlola. Uthi: "Utshwala bonile umzimba wakho. Uma uqhubeka uphuza, uzokona impilo yakho yonke."

ULangelihle uyamangala. Akazi ukuthi utshwala bubi kakhulu. Abangane bakhe nabo bayamangala. USiphokazi uyasondela kuLangelihle. Uthi: "Ngikuthanda kakhulu. Kodwa angifuni ukushada nendoda ephuza utshwala nsuku zonke."

ULangelihle uthi: "Uqinisile. Lokhu kuzoba yisiqalo esisha." Uyeka utshwala. Usebenza kanzima, futhi ubuyisa imali yabangane bakhe. Ubuyisa imali kancane, nyanga zonke. Ngemuva kwezinyanga eziyisithupha isikweletu sakhe siyaphela. Akaqambi amanga futhi.

Ngonyaka olandelayo uLangelihle noSiphokazi bayashada. Bayathandana kakhulu, futhi uLangelihle akaphuzi utshwala.

Imibuzo:
ULangelihle noSiphokazi bayathandana na?
Kunjalo, bathandana kakhulu.
ULangelihle unesikweletu na?
Kunjalo, unesikweletu esikhulu.
ULangelihle uqamba amanga kuSiphokazi na?
Kunjalo, uqamba amanga.
Udokotela uthi utshwala bonile umzimba wakhe na?
Kunjalo, uthi utshwala bonile umzimba wakhe.
ULangelihle ubuyisa imali yabangane bakhe na?
Kunjalo, uyibuyisa kancane, nyanga zonke.

lessons.title: Amehlo kaNosipho
lessons.summary: Schoolgirl Nosipho in Pretoria cannot read the board, leans over her desk and watches films with the phone close to her eyes; teacher Thulisile moves her to the centre of the room, an eye doctor measures her face for glasses, and her classmates gather round to see them.
lessons.text:
UNosipho ufunda esikoleni ePitoli. Uhlala emuva, eduze nomnyango. Umfundisi wakhe, uThulisile, ubhala amagama ebhodini. Kodwa uNosipho akakwazi ukufunda amagama ebhodini. Uncika phambili, ukhangela ibhodi isikhathi eside. Amagama mancane kakhulu kuye.

Emini ilanga liyakhanya esikoleni. Lapho ilanga likhanya ebhodini, uNosipho akaboni lutho. Uma uThulisile eme eduze nebhodi, isithunzi sakhe sisebhodini. Esithunzini uNosipho akaboni lutho futhi.

Ekhaya uNosipho ubukela amafilimu ocingweni lukamama wakhe. Ubeka ucingo eduze kakhulu namehlo akhe. Unina uthi: "Ungabukeli eduze kakhulu." Kodwa uNosipho akalaleli. Ubukela amafilimu isikhathi eside.

Ngolunye usuku uThulisile ubona uNosipho encika phambili. Uthi: "Nosipho, woza uhlale ephakathi, eduze nebhodi." UNosipho uhlala ephakathi kwabafundi, kodwa namanje akaboni kahle. Uncika phambili futhi, ukhangela ibhodi.

UThulisile ushayela unina kaNosipho ucingo. Unina uthatha uNosipho, baye kudokotela wamehlo. Udokotela umkhombisa ibhodi elinamagama. Amagama okuqala makhulu, kodwa amagama aphansi mancane kakhulu. UNosipho ukhangela ibhodi, kodwa ufunda amagama amakhulu kuphela.

Udokotela uthi: "Amehlo akhe adinga izibuko." Ulinganisa ubude nobubanzi bobuso bukaNosipho. Uthi: "Ngifuna ukwazi ubude nobubanzi bobuso bakhe. Izibuko kumele zimlingane kahle."

Ngemuva kwesonto uNosipho ufika esikoleni nezibuko ezintsha. Abafundi bayamzungeza. Bonke bafuna ukubona izibuko zakhe. Bamzungeza isikhathi eside, bakhuluma kakhulu. UNosipho uyajabula.

Manje uNosipho ukhangela ibhodi, futhi ufunda amagama onke. Akanciki phambili. Ilanga liyakhanya, kodwa namanje uyabona kahle.

Imibuzo:
UNosipho uyakwazi ukufunda ibhodi ekuqaleni na?
Cha, akakwazi ukufunda amagama ebhodini.
UNosipho uncika phambili na?
Kunjalo, uncika phambili, ukhangela ibhodi.
UThulisile uthi uNosipho ahlale ephakathi na?
Kunjalo, uthi ahlale ephakathi, eduze nebhodi.
Udokotela ulinganisa ubude nobubanzi bobuso bakhe na?
Kunjalo, ulinganisa ubude nobubanzi bobuso bakhe.
Abafundi bamzungeza uNosipho na?
Kunjalo, bamzungeza, bafuna ukubona izibuko zakhe.

lessons.title: UZamokuhle uyalungela
lessons.summary: Young boxer Zamokuhle in Johannesburg copies famous fighters, but his coach Sbongile teaches him to fight wisely: she fixes his stance, throws him balls to catch, and makes him rest when he passes his body's limit; he wins his big fight and enjoys the feeling of victory.
lessons.text:
UZamokuhle uyinsizwa yaseGoli. Uthanda ukulwa. Ubukela amafilimu abalwi abadumile, abalingise. Ulingisa indlela abahamba ngayo, ulingisa nendlela abalwa ngayo. Abangane bakhe bathi: "Uyabalingisa kahle!"

Umqeqeshi wakhe, uSbongile, uhlakaniphile. Uthi: "Zamokuhle, ungalingisi abanye abalwi. Umuntu ohlakaniphile ulwa ngendlela yakhe." Bese uthi: "Sizoqala ngokuma kwakho. Ukuma kwakho akukuhle. Umzimba wakho uncika phambili kakhulu." USbongile umkhombisa ukuma okufanele. UZamokuhle ufunda ukuma kahle.

Ekuseni bayagijima ndawonye. Bese uSbongile uphonsa ibhola. UZamokuhle ulibamba ngesandla esisodwa. USbongile uphonsa elinye ibhola, alibambe ngesinye isandla. Uphonsa amabhola amaningi, futhi uwaphonsa ngokushesha.

UZamokuhle ulungela ukulwa okukhulu ngoMgqibelo. Ulungela kakhulu. Usebenza ekuseni, emini nasebusuku. USbongile uthi: "Umzimba unomkhawulo. Ungasebenzi ngaphezu komkhawulo wakho." Kodwa uZamokuhle akalaleli.

NgoLwesithathu uzwa umuzwa omubi esandleni sakhe. Ulimazile isandla sakhe. USbongile uthi: "Ngikutshelile. Manje phumula izinsuku ezimbili. Umuntu ohlakaniphile uyazi umkhawulo wakhe." UZamokuhle uyaphumula. Umuzwa omubi esandleni uyaphela.

NgoMgqibelo uZamokuhle ulwa nensizwa enkulu yasePitoli. Ukuma kwakhe kuhle manje. Akalingisi muntu. Ulwa ngokuhlakanipha. Insizwa yasePitoli inamandla, kodwa uZamokuhle uhlakaniphile kunayo. Ekugcineni uyanqoba.

Ukunqoba kuyamjabulisa kakhulu. Unina uyajabula, noSbongile uyajabula. Ukunqoba kwakhe kubajabulisa bonke. UZamokuhle uthi: "Umuzwa wokunqoba umnandi kakhulu. Kodwa ukunqoba kuvela ekulungeleni kahle. Umuntu ohlakaniphile uyaphumula futhi."

Imibuzo:
UZamokuhle uhlala eGoli na?
Kunjalo, uyinsizwa yaseGoli.
USbongile uthi ukuma kwakhe kuhle ekuqaleni na?
Cha, uthi ukuma kwakhe akukuhle.
USbongile uphonsa amabhola na?
Kunjalo, uphonsa amabhola amaningi.
UZamokuhle usebenza ngaphezu komkhawulo wakhe na?
Kunjalo, futhi ulimaza isandla sakhe.
Ukunqoba kuyamjabulisa uZamokuhle na?
Kunjalo, kuyamjabulisa kakhulu.

lessons.title: Ibhokisi elivela phesheya
lessons.summary: Nurse Nompilo at a small Kokstad hospital gets word from her relative Nkazimulo, a doctor overseas in London, that he is sending a box of medicine; after its long journey the box is opened, she gives each patient a share and passes the rest on to another hospital.
lessons.text:
UNompilo usebenza esibhedlela esincane eKokstad. Unakekela abantu abanezifo. Kodwa isibhedlela sakhe asinayo imithi eyanele. Isihlobo sakhe, uNkazimulo, ungudokotela phesheya, eLondon.

Ngolunye usuku uNkazimulo ubhala incwadi. Uthi: "Ngizothumela ibhokisi elikhulu lemithi esibhedlela sakho. Ibhokisi lizohamba uhambo olude." UNompilo uyajabula. Utshela abasebenzi abanye: "Isihlobo sami esiphesheya sithumela imithi."

Uhambo lwebhokisi lude kakhulu. Ibhokisi liphuma eLondon ngomkhumbi. Lifika eThekwini ngemuva kwamasonto amane. Bese lihamba ngemoto ukusuka eThekwini kuya eKokstad. Uhambo lwalo luthatha inyanga yonke.

Mhla ibhokisi lifika, abantu abaningi balinde esibhedlela. Umnyango wesibhedlela uyavuleka. Amadoda amabili angena nebhokisi elikhulu. Ibhokisi livulwa nguNompilo, abantu bonke bayabuka. Ngaphakathi kwebhokisi elivuliwe kunemithi eminingi.

UNompilo wabela abantu abanezifo imithi. Umuntu ngamunye uthola isabelo sakhe. Isabelo somuntu omdala sikhulu kunesabelo sengane. UNompilo ubhala igama lomuntu ngamunye nesabelo sakhe ephepheni.

Imithi iningi kakhulu. Ngakho uNompilo wedlulisa eminye imithi esibhedlela esinye esiseduze. Lapho nabo bayajabula.

Ebusuku uNompilo ubhala incwadi kuNkazimulo. Uthi: "Mhla ibhokisi lakho lifika, umnyango wethu wavuleka, nethemba lavuleka. Ibhokisi lavulwa lapho kukhona abantu abaningi. Ngabela abantu bonke isabelo sabo. Ngedlulisa nemithi eminye kwesinye isibhedlela. Siyabonga kakhulu." UNkazimulo ufunda incwadi phesheya, ajabule kakhulu.

Imibuzo:
UNompilo usebenza esibhedlela eKokstad na?
Kunjalo, usebenza esibhedlela esincane eKokstad.
Isihlobo sakhe sihlala phesheya na?
Kunjalo, uNkazimulo ungudokotela phesheya, eLondon.
Uhambo lwebhokisi lufushane na?
Cha, uhambo lwalo lude kakhulu.
Umuntu ngamunye uthola isabelo sakhe na?
Kunjalo, uthola isabelo sakhe semithi.
UNompilo wedlulisa eminye imithi na?
Kunjalo, wedlulisa eminye imithi esibhedlela esinye.

lessons.title: Izinwele zikaThembelihle
lessons.summary: Thembelihle of Umlazi finds her hair falling out and tries many kinds of oil without success; a doctor analyses one hair and tells her to eat many kinds of food, and her father, who carves wood, carves her a wooden comb and tells her in fine old isiZulu that all mankind loves good hair.
lessons.text:
UThembelihle uhlala eMlazi. Unesitolo esincane sezingubo. Izinwele zakhe zinde futhi zinhle. Kodwa ngolunye usuku ubona izinwele eziningi phansi. Unwele ngalunye luyawa. Uyabuza: "Kwenzakalani ezinweleni zami?"

UThembelihle ulinga izinhlobo eziningi zamafutha. Ulinga uhlobo lokuqala, bese elinga olunye. Ulinga izinhlobo ezinhlanu. Kodwa izinwele ziqhubeka ziwa. Akazi ukuthi kwenzakalani.

Uthi kumngane wakhe: "Ngicela ungibhekele isitolo sami. Ngiya kudokotela." Umngane wakhe uyavuma. Uthi: "Ngizokubhekela isitolo. Hamba kahle."

Udokotela uthatha unwele olulodwa. Uyaluhlaziya. Uhlaziya unwele isikhathi eside. Bese uthi: "Awunasifo. Okwenzakalayo yikuthi ukudla kwakho akwanele. Udla uhlobo olulodwa lokudla kuphela. Yidla izinhlobo eziningi zokudla. Futhi ungakhohlwa ukuphumula."

UThembelihle uya ekhaya kuyise. Uyise ubaza izinto ngokhuni. Uneqoqo elikhulu lezinto azibazile. Iqoqo lakhe linezinhlobo eziningi zezinto: izinkomo ezincane, izinja ezincane nezitsha.

UThembelihle utshela uyise konke. Uyise ubaza into entsha. Ubaza ikamu elihle lezinwele. Uthi ngesiZulu esihle: "Ndodakazi yami, sebenzisa le nto kancane. Izinwele zakho zizokhula futhi." UThembelihle ubeka ikamu eqoqweni lezinto zakhe ezinhle.

Uyise uthi: "Isintu sonke sithanda izinwele ezinhle. Kusukela kudala isintu sinakekela izinwele. Kodwa izinwele ezinhle zivela emzimbeni ophile kahle." Uyise ukhuluma isiZulu sakudala, futhi uThembelihle uyalalela.

Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezintathu izinwele zikaThembelihle ziyakhula futhi. Akwenzakali lutho olubi. Ubonga umngane wakhe ngokumbhekela isitolo, abonge noyise ngeqoqo lakhe elihle.

Imibuzo:
UThembelihle ubona izinwele eziningi phansi na?
Kunjalo, ubona izinwele eziningi phansi.
Ulinga izinhlobo eziningi zamafutha na?
Kunjalo, ulinga izinhlobo ezinhlanu.
Udokotela uyaluhlaziya unwele na?
Kunjalo, uluhlaziya isikhathi eside.
Uyise ubaza izinto ngokhuni na?
Kunjalo, ubaza izinto ngokhuni.
Uyise ukhuluma isiZulu sakudala na?
Kunjalo, ukhuluma isiZulu sakudala.
